subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which item in a First Aid box is used to immobilize a fractured limb?
questions.explain: A splint is a rigid material used to support and keep a broken bone or injured limb from moving, preventing further injury.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Mouth-to-mouth resuscitation is a technique used when a victim has stopped:
questions.explain: Mouth-to-mouth resuscitation is widely used to provide artificial ventilation to a person who is not breathing.
